title: Possibly weird question?
content: Were anyone else's dreams weirdly violent last night? This might seem long winded, but I have a point, I promise. Normally I just hang out around the fairgrounds or the giant casino/mall, but the past few days, I've visited a kind of futuristic mall? Like how people in the 80s thought malls would be. Stores on moving tracks that you can choose from a catalog. I was being stalked by this guy, and he had this lackey that can best be described as looking like Quasimodo if he chose evil and steroids. But that all came to a head last night, and I ended up killing both of them because they were trying to assault me. After it happened, I joined my friends in a cafeteria, still covered in blood, and they told me, "The men in black are coming. They're going to report they killed each other because "they were behaving in a way that we don't do in this world." So I guess a second weird question is, has anyone experienced anything like this? Specifically with mentions of men in black?
